requirements_summary: Workload: SaaS customer KB retrieval; multi-tenant per-customer indices; average corpus per tenant 500k-1.5M docs; aggregate index ~3M docs
QPS: baseline 100-200 qps, peak 300-400 qps during support hours, burst tolerance to 600 qps
Latency SLO: 95th percentile retrieval+rerank < 150ms (interactive support chat); ideal end-to-end < 120ms
Cost sensitivity: wants to keep average cost_per_query under $0.010 at baseline QPS; willing to trade accuracy for cost on low-priority routes
Retrieval architecture preference: hybrid (BM25 for recall + dense embeddings for semantic match) with a cross-encoder reranker for top-20 candidates
Embedding ops: daily re-indexing for delta docs; prefer 1536-d or 1024-d embeddings; evaluate Redwood's embedding hosting vs self-managed
Indexing throughput: initial backfill 3M docs over 2 weeks, steady-state daily delta ~50k docs/hour during business hours
Cache/cold start needs: warm KV/prefix cache important for morning spikes; want guidance on TTLs and pre-warming
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logging for query traces, KMS-managed keys for any stored vectors, GDPR/region residency for EU tenants
notes: AE notes: Midtown team is engineering-heavy; cares about clear cost math and predictable latency. Prefers hosted API if performance/cost checks out.
From CE: two-stage pipeline they want — ANN index (HNSW) + CPU cross-encoder reranker (distil-cross-encoder baseline) for highest precision on support answers.
Client quote: 'We can tolerate a fast approximate answer for discovery but need the reranker to push the best answer into chat rapidly.'
Index size: expect average doc length 800 tokens; also many short faq-like docs (50-200 tokens) which skew recall semantics.
Vector DB: currently experimenting with a managed vector DB but open to Redwood-managed embedding + index if cost and latency are better.
POC ask: 72-hour soak at 300 QPS with two tenants simulated, full backfill pipeline running, show cost breakdown token vs embedding compute.
Reranker latency target: single-cross-encoder pass under 80ms at 1k qps equivalent on Redwood infra — client to verify with sample corpus.
Data residency: US primary, EU tenant subset needs EU residency; client will need clear docs on region routing and fallbacks.
Eval metrics: recall@20, NDCG@10 after rerank, median latency, p95 latency, cost_per_query — want Redwood Optimize recommendations to hit targets.
Legal/Procurement: waiting for DPA + SOC2; procurement expects SOC2/ISO evidence before signing enterprise terms.
